title: Retention Statement Flood Disbursement Rule
content:
Statement flood disbursement on a retention statement (Payoff and Loan Satisfaction)

**Rule.** On the payoff case of a Borrower Voluntary Payoff requested by the borrower of record on a loan whose maturity case is due and payable, in its extension period or referred to foreclosure, the statement flood disbursement enters the retention statement balance. It is the statement bill of type flood insurance bill limited to the set-aside's set-aside balance less its statement bills of types property tax bill and hazard insurance bill, not below 0.00, when that set-aside is a Fully Funded LESA, and that flood bill in full when it is a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve; a loan with no such bill or no such set-aside carries nothing (0.00). The set-aside is the one held under the Set-Aside Accounts product that pays the loan's property charges.

**Statement bills.** A statement bill is, for each of property tax bill, hazard insurance bill and flood insurance bill, the received bill of that type with the latest due date on the set-aside that pays the loan's property charges, an active Fully Funded LESA (Mandatory), an active Fully Funded LESA (Borrower-Elected) or an active Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve, when its payment date falls no later than 30 calendar days after the statement date; a bill's payment date is its due date less the set-aside plan's tax payment lead days for a tax bill and less its insurance payment lead days for a hazard or flood bill. Where several such bills of one type share that latest due date, their billed amounts are taken together as that type's bill. The 30 days are the plan's good-through period.

**Questions answered by the rule.**

*What is the flood bill limited to on a Fully Funded LESA?* The set-aside balance less the tax statement bill and less the hazard statement bill, and never less than 0.00.

*Is a flood bill on a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve limited?* No; it is carried in full.

*What if no flood bill was received?* Nothing is carried.

*Hypothetical:* balance USD 2000.00, tax statement bill USD 900.00, hazard statement bill USD 600.00, flood statement bill USD 750.00: the room left is USD 500.00, so the statement flood disbursement is USD 500.00.
